issue.title: Test Gap: test config in watchdog.yml for nexthop device NH-5010

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the test gap

In watchdog.yml, the nexthop regex doesn't match new nexthop_5010 device and the default is not compatible

### Affected Area

All of test_watchdog.py and nexthop_5010 device

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

All of test_watchdog.py fail for nexthop_5010 device

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
New nexthop devices are not using the correct watchdog values, and are not compatible with the default.

#### How did you do it?
Generalize the watchdog config regex for all nexthop devices.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run sonic-mgmt test_watchdog.py on nexthop devices, including `x86_64-nexthop_5010-r.*` Make sure all tests in test_watchdog.py pass without causing additional test failures.
